entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To connect with sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For questions about an existing order or returns, press three.
Three! Just get me a person!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand. It's useless. I want my money back. My order number is VF-8675309.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse from December 20th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, I just don't like it! The stats are useless to me and the fit is uncomfortable. I want to return it. End of story.
I understand. I'm looking at the delivery date, and it shows it was delivered to you on December 20th, which was about 25 days ago. Unfortunately, I won't be able to process a return for you today.
WHAT?! What do you mean you can't process it? That's ridiculous! I want my money back!

I understand your frustration, but for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, our return **policy** is 10 days from the date of receipt. Because it has been 25 days, it's unfortunately **too late** to start a return.
Ten days? Are you kidding me? That's insane! This is a scam! I'm going to leave a one-star review on every website I can find. Get me your manager right now! This is unacceptable!

Sir, I can assure you it's not a scam. The 10-day window is in place for very specific health and safety reasons. Because the device is worn directly on the skin, we have an extremely strict **hygiene** **policy**. After that 10-day period, we can't accept it back due to **sanitation** protocols and the risk of bio-contaminants.
I don't care about your sanitation! I wore it twice! This is the worst customer service I have ever experienced. I demand to speak to your supervisor. They can approve this.

I am the highest point of contact for this issue, as a manager would have to refer to the exact same safety **policy**. There are no exceptions we can make when it comes to the health and **hygiene** rules for wearable electronics. The system physically prevents us from creating a return label for this item after the 10-day mark.
Unbelievable! You just lost a customer for life, and I'm going to make sure everyone I know hears about this. This is theft! You sold me a product with a trap of a return policy! Fine! Useless!
I am truly sorry we couldn't find a resolution for you today. I have noted your feedback on the account. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
